checkpoint_selection: first saved eligible paragraph boundary at or after each target, before terminal; unavailable and duplicate states explicitly recorded
state_distribution_warning: offline state selection uses realized trajectory eligibility; not an online selection rule or a population prevalence estimate
seed_coupling: same answer seeds across actions; separate thought seeds; DEFER branches share prefix of FULL for each thought seed
cost_scope: offline action timing only; not measured end-to-end cost of a learned deployment policy
missing_state_policy: retain and report eligibility failures; do not silently replace with easier questions
